loop.top3_why_not: Candidate B is almost identical in performance but uses a less aggressive shrinkage (w2) and a stable subset of models; the slight increase in variance makes it a marginally less robust choice. Candidate C (mean) has a higher validation score and slightly worse per‑window errors, and it does not exploit the error‑based weighting that is advantageous for a trend‑dominated series with unstable model performance.
